lane: Billing lot 2b: approved Premium screen design and honest 'For Premium' labels on locked decks and guides
goal: Restyle PaywallPanel to the approved Premium design (Garamond hero with a small constellation, three benefits, two radio plan cards with a short saving chip, gold buy button, renewal and cancel note, Restore purchases and Manage plan, Terms and Privacy, a 'Still free' block, and the state cards) using the app theme tokens, without changing purchase, restore or identify logic and with store prices only. Replace 'Sắp ra mắt' / 'Coming soon' on locked Premium decks and guides with a 'Dành cho Premium' label and a plain explanation; show a 'Xem gói Premium' button that opens Profile > Premium only while the paywall is shown (premiumOnSale or EXPO_PUBLIC_BILLING_TEST).
successCriteria: PaywallPanel matches the approved layout for plans, loading, signed-out, purchasing, pending, error, unavailable, active, ending and restore results; prices come only from the store; the source still contains no fixed price, credit wording or vendor name.
Purchase, restore, identify and offer loading behave exactly as before (existing PaywallPanel tests still pass, adjusted only for new visual wording).
All interactive controls have accessibilityRole and accessibilityLabel and at least 44 pt touch targets; text wraps on narrow phones.
Locked Premium decks and guides show 'Dành cho Premium' with the approved explanation in Vietnamese and English; 'Sắp ra mắt' no longer appears for decks or guides.

A 'Xem gói Premium' button appears on the lock notice only when the paywall is enabled and opens the Profile Premium section; without the paywall only the label and explanation show; both branches are tested.
tsc, the mobile jest suite, validate:governance, the admin workflow catalog check and this preflight pass.
untouchedSurfaces: packages/agent-config/account-tier-policy.json keeps premiumOnSale false; paywallAccess.ts, usePremium.ts and billingClient.ts logic are unchanged.
supabase/, apps/web and Admin behaviour are untouched; only the App.tsx source digest in apps/admin/workflow-catalog.js is refreshed.
Lot 3 files (account deletion, legal pages, DeleteAccountBillingNotice) are not edited; App.tsx edits stay limited to the locked deck and guide copy and wiring.
No EAS build, release, secret, SQL or deploy; no .env file is read.

impact.entryPoint: Profile > Premium (PaywallPanel); Tarot deck list, deck detail and draw step for Premium decks; guide list and guide detail for Premium guides.
impact.dataWrite: None. Visual and copy change only; no new storage, events or network calls.
impact.backendContract: No backend contract change; the paywall still reads offers and customer info through the existing billing client.
impact.adminVisibility: No Admin change apart from the App.tsx source digest in the workflow catalog.
impact.privacySafety: No new data is read or sent. Labels promise nothing beyond what the account tier already enforces.
impact.observability: Existing premium_deck_preview event is kept; no new logging.
impact.rollback: Revert the commit; the previous paywall layout and labels return.

managerTestPath: In a closed-test build with EXPO_PUBLIC_BILLING_TEST=true: open Profile > Premium and compare with the approved design; open a Premium deck and a Premium guide and check the 'Dành cho Premium' label, the explanation and the 'Xem gói Premium' button. In a normal build the same places show the label and explanation without a button.
residualRisk: Not yet seen on a real device or narrow phone; the per-month equivalent line and the payment-problem (past_due) card from the mockup are not built because the app has no formatted price helper or past_due data yet.
